# Mail location changes clear the stale hovered-link display

A content progress location event calls setOverLink("") to discard the old hovered URL. The shared forwarding layer ignores hidden browsers. This location callback is separate from the browser-specific busy-state callback. Empty input clears the hover label or status overlay, while the activity status channel remains separate. No navigation or live status-bar test ran.

Scope: mail/status-feedback.
